items.text: Students and parents ask this in many forms.
Accountancy is arithmetic with rules: journal entries, ledgers, balance sheets.
It targets practical maths for business, finance and economics.
This is the short list that deserves the word "closed".
In Delhi University's 2026-27 undergraduate bulletin, BMS and BBA (FIA) ask for Mathematics/Applied Mathematics plus one subject from List B and the General Aptitude Test.
IIM Amritsar's admission policy asks for Mathematics or Applied Mathematics as a compulsory Class 12 paper.
CA is the question asked most often, so it gets its own honest look.
Foundation Paper 3 is Quantitative Aptitude: Business Mathematics, Statistics and Logical Reasoning.
ICAI's own FAQ says you pass the Foundation with at least 40 per cent in each paper and 50 per cent in aggregate, at one sitting, with 0.25 negative marking on wrong answers in the objective papers.

blocks.heading: Doors People Wrongly Call Closed
rows: "B.Com (Hons) at DU is impossible without maths"

DU's 2026-27 bulletin lists a combination with Accountancy/Book Keeping instead of Mathematics for B.Com (Hons). A few coaching pages say this route was removed. The bulletin says otherwise, so check the current one.

The CFA Institute's enrolment policy asks for a completed bachelor's degree, a bachelor's programme that ends within 23 months of the Level I exam window, or 4,000 hours of work and/or higher education over at least three years. It lists no Class 12 maths condition. The exams themselves are quantitative, so it is a hard road, not a locked door.

ICAI lets you register in the Foundation after Class 10, with no stream condition. Paper 3 (Quantitative Aptitude) is real maths, so you learn it there, and graduates with 55% (commerce) or 60% (other streams) can skip the Foundation entirely.

ICSI's restructured entrance test (CSEET) has four papers: Business Communication, Fundamentals of Accounting, Economic and Business Environment, and Business Laws and Management. None is a maths or quantitative paper. Details are in the Company Secretary section below.

IIM Indore's own 2026-31 admission document lists no maths subject condition, and prep sources report the same for IIM Rohtak, Ranchi, Jammu and Bodh Gaya. But IIM Indore's test has three 40-minute sections, and two are Quantitative Ability.

SBI's current PO advertisement (CRPD/PO/2026-27/09) asks for graduation in any discipline. The prelims carry a Quantitative Aptitude section, reported as 30 of 100 marks in 20 minutes, which you prepare for like any other section.

blocks.heading: Much of Each Exam Is Actually Quant
rows: Paper 3 of 4, so 100 of 400 marks (25%). Objective, with negative marking.
ICAI FAQ; paper split from prep sources
Paper 3, Fundamentals of Business Mathematics and Statistics, is one of four papers.
None of the four papers is a quantitative paper. Fundamentals of Accounting is the numbers-heavy one.
Quantitative Aptitude is 30 of 100 marks in 20 minutes. Mains adds Data Analysis and Interpretation at 60 of 230 marks.
SBI advertisement; pattern from prep sources
Two of three 40-minute sections are Quantitative Ability, at 4 marks a question, with negative marking on the multiple-choice one.
About 10 to 14 of 120 questions (roughly 10%) are Quantitative Techniques.

items.text: "No maths means no CA, no BBA, no MBA." Wrong on all three: CA takes any stream, most BBA programmes do not GATE on maths, and MBA entrances ask for a degree.
"Take maths anyway, just in case." Fine if you can sustain it, costly if it damages your marks and confidence.
"Websites list what you can do, so trust the list." The popular lists contradict each other and sometimes the official documents.

blocks.heading: Applied Maths Middle Path Most Families Miss

items.text: You want DU's BMS, BBA (FIA) or Economics Honours to stay possible, since these accept "Mathematics/Applied Mathematics".
You are comfortable with practical, business-style problems but not pure maths.
You are still in Class 10 or the start of Class 11.

blocks.heading: Open, But with a Quant Section Waiting

items.text: CA Foundation Paper 3: business mathematics, statistics and logical reasoning, as 100 multiple-choice questions
SBI PO prelims: a timed Quantitative Aptitude section
IPMAT: quantitative ability, in two of three sections at IIM Indore
CAT and other MBA entrances: a quantitative section built on school-level topics

blocks.heading: Short First Test You Can Run Alone

items.text: Pick two paths.
Read the official eligibility line for each.
Sit one timed quant section or sample paper.
Produce one small piece of work in each path.
Show it to two people who work in that field.
Decide, then review after a stretch of consistent work.

blocks.heading: What Parents Can Check Before Spending

items.text: Ask which exact course and college.
Is it a Class 12 subject, or a timed section in an entrance test.
Check the total cost against the budget.
Ask what the child can show in a year.
Keep one backup route alive.
